audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill', contradicting packet.levelChart (Poppy,Poppy,Poppy,Taric,Taric,Taric,Taric) and content.win[0-6] which already state Poppy for 0-2 and Taric for 3-6.
audit.why: Poppy's level 1-3 Heroic Charge wall-pin and W passive dash-block outpace Taric's not-yet-online sustain; from level 4-5 Taric's double-cast Q, Bastion shield and Dazzle stun out-value her single-target burst. Content layer already reflects this correctly.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2].side -> Poppy; phases[3-6].side -> Taric; ratings and whys rewritten to match the verdict.

audit.why: Level 6 spike (Cosmic Radiance flips Poppy all-ins), first item (Q/Bastion sustain outpaces her burst), and late (R timing dominates 2v2s) are already correctly stated in spikes[] — kept as-is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy's R Keeper's Verdict is a channel (per enemyKit flags) — Taric's E Dazzle, a hard-CC stun, cancels it outright on cast. This interaction is in missingInteractions but wasn't stated anywhere in the current text.
audit.why: Channeled ultimates are cancelled by any CC; Taric's E lands a stun with a brief delay, so catching Poppy mid-channel turns her all-in into a wasted 100-140s cooldown.
